html:
When life runs, you feel like running away from it and when life takes rest you want to run like crazy.

When your family is around you want that 10 minutes of solitude but when you are lonely you seek family’s presence rightaway.

Lazy days do not create a memory, so when somebody asks what did you do we say ‘Nothing’ but what it does is to prepare our mind for the act which would create memory in the mind of thousands of people.

Happy Lazy Sunday
